title: Paper 2-D shapes
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Place value within 100; money; time
intro: Lesson 85: Shape revisit: name and sort 2-D and 3-D shapes. To understand how to name and sort 2-D and 3-D shapes

blocks.text: Also draw a circle and a triangle on card and cut them out.

questions.q: A box of tissues is a...?
questions.model: Teacher: flat faces, rectangles: a cuboid.

questions.q: Find a cube, a sphere and a cylinder at home. Show the camera.
Which 3-D shape can roll and stack?

questions.a: Flat shapes are 2-D; solid shapes you can hold are 3-D.
